messages:
Alyssa (CS): Quick weekly check-in for Mercator — p95/p99 latency split by route + streaming vs non-streaming. Posting the top-level numbers, flagged anything >1.5x baseline.

Alyssa (CS): Summary: overall usage +18% week-over-week, spend +12%. Most traffic on /chat and /generate. Streaming p99 is where we're seeing the largest deltas.

Alyssa (CS): Snapshot (UTC window: last 7d):
```
Route       | Model                 | Mode        | p95(ms) | p99(ms) | 5xx%
/chat       | redwood-4o-v1          | streaming   | 220     | 630     | 0.9%
/chat       | redwood-4o-v1          | non-stream  | 140     | 260     | 0.3%
/generate   | redwood-3.5-compact    | non-stream  | 95      | 180     | 0.1%
/generate   | redwood-4o-v1          | streaming   | 270     | 700     | 1.2%
/embeddings | emb-small-v2           | non-stream  | 40      | 120     | 0.02%
```

Alyssa (CS): Notes: streaming p99 for /chat and /generate up ~2.4x vs baseline. Root cause unknown — could be KV cache misses + larger batch tails. Also saw a small spike in 5xxs for streaming on /chat.

Mike (SRE): ops-bot flagged elevated 5xx for /chat streaming this morning at 03:12 UTC. I pulled traces — lots of long tail on chunk assembly and a few OOM-ish container restarts.

Mike (SRE): Quick mitigation suggestions: lower max_concurrent_streams to 8 for the canary pool, enable prefix KV caching for chat routes, and temporarily pin canary traffic to redwood-3.5-compact for non-critical customers.

Jordan (AE): Renewal touchpoint next month — Mercator consumes a lot of streaming tokens. If latency keeps acting up their product team may ask for Dedicated pricing to stabilize. Marking renewal risk as "monitoring" for now.

Sabrina (Customer): Thanks for the heads up. From our side the production team noticed UI stutters when p99 spikes. We can tolerate slightly higher p95, but p99 above ~500ms breaks the streaming UX.

Alyssa (CS): Got it — priority is to keep streaming p99 under 500ms for Mercator. Will create a canary with the config changes Mike suggested and route 10% of traffic.

ops-bot: [alert] 2026-06-02T03:12:07Z Incident: elevated 5xx rate on route=/chat mode=streaming pod=ci-rt-47 restart_count=2

Mike (SRE): Command I ran:
```
kubectl -n redwood rollout restart deployment/rt-canary
# reduced max_concurrent_streams in helm values
```

Alyssa (CS): Action items
- Alyssa: create canary with reduced max_concurrent_streams + prefix cache (started).
- Mike: monitor p95/p99 and attach traces if p99 > 500ms after canary.
- Jordan: mention possible Dedicated conversation in renewal briefing if p99 doesn't stabilize.
- Sabrina: let us know if you can shift any non-critical traffic to non-streaming for next 72h (would help).

Sabrina (Customer): We can move background summarization to non-streaming for 48h, will confirm by EOD.

Alyssa (CS): Thanks — I'll follow up with a short status update tomorrow. :thumbsup:

Mike (SRE): I'll post a quick perf diff once the canary hits 10% traffic.

Alyssa (CS): Closing loop: if anyone sees new 5xxs or p99 regressions, ping #incidents and @Alyssa.
